snippet.title: Growth - Automate & Collect | Cozy Farming Automation Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Build, automate, and grow your dream farm from scratch.

Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3119210/Growth/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=channeldescription&utm_campaign=wishlist_push

Follow development live on Stream:
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@growth_de
Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/growthdevlog/

Plant crops, get machines, catch and level animals, and create fully automated production chains, finish the collection book in this relaxing farming automation game.

Start small and transform your farm into a powerful automated system.

Features:
• Cozy and relaxing gameplay
• Automation and production chains
• Crafting and progression
• Satisfying and rewarding growth

Made with Godot Engine.

#cozygames #farminggame #indiegame #simulationgame
